name: dataset50
description: 50 source papers, 10 per field (robotics, interpretability, vision, NLP, math + ML theory), 100 claims; format-2 shared subfield cards.
card_text: arXiv HTML main body first, PDF main body fallback
subfield_classifier: gpt-6-luna, classifier._PROMPT on each claim, 3 samples, labels kept when >= 2 agree; then datasets/dataset50/build/scripts/consolidate.py (merges, catch-all drops, 7 hand removals, cards need >= 2 papers)
gather: subfield_gather: gpt-6-luna queries from subfield name + keywords, gpt-6-luna relevance screen, full-text-only candidates, source papers removed (leakage.py)
notes: Selection: main-track 2026 venue in the arXiv comment, arXiv v1 >= 2026-02-01; exceptions kept from the original 20 are listed in datasets/dataset50/build/drafts/SKIPPED.md and the dataset50 memory (2510.20487 pre-cutoff, 2608.09928 workshop, Findings papers).
Science papers are held out for a later test set (datasets/dataset50/build/science_heldout.json).
